1. **Layer 1 (Physical)**: Transmits raw bit streams over physical media – *Ethernet*
2. **Layer 2 (Data Link)**: Provides node-to-node data transfer – *MAC addresses*
3. **Layer 3 (Network)**: Handles packet forwarding and routing – *IP/TCP*
4. **Layer 4 (Transport)**: Ensures end-to-end communication – *UDP*
5. **Layer 5 (Session)**: Manages connections between applications – *NetBIOS*
6. **Layer 6 (Presentation)**: Translates data for the application layer – *SSL/TLS*
7. **Layer 7 (Application)**: Provides network services to end-user apps – *HTTP/HTTPS*

1. 1 - Physical - Ethernet
2. 2 - Data Link - PPP
3. 3 - Network - IP (Internet Protocol)
4. 4 - Transport - TCP (Transmission Control Protocol) / UDP (User Datagram Protocol)
5. 5 - Session - NetBIOS (Network Basic Input/Output System)
6. 6 - Presentation - SSL/TLS (Secure Sockets Layer/Transport Layer Security)
7. 7 - Application - HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol), FTP (File Transfer Protocol)
